source.version: Part 12 — Trichomes and Cannabinoid Biosynthesis — Batch 04
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-236–240 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 12 manuscript plus longitudinal cannabis storage/degradation studies, direct genotype/environment and inflorescence-position studies, direct trichome maturation microscopy, 2025–2026 stage/variability evidence, pharmacopeial sampling guidance, and an independent 2025 potency-label audit. Public wording rejects one-to-one THC-loss/CBN assumptions, universal G×E effects, universal harvest weeks, trichome color as a chemical assay, and single-sample or label values as proof of batch uniformity.
source.note: This batch completes controlled Volume 12 — Trichomes and Cannabinoid Biosynthesis — through degradation, G×E, developmental accumulation, trichome-color evidence boundaries, and defensible cannabinoid sampling/testing claims.
